For brands and clubs

Put your brand in front of engaged fans.

Every campaign you run with us helps you learn what matters most to real customers, while giving them something worth celebrating.

Talk to us ↓

Giveaways

A prize your customers actually want, promoted to every Mega Rewards subscriber and free for them to enter.

Includes
  • Prize sourced with you or supplied by you
  • Branded landing page and entry form
  • Email to the full subscriber base
  • Reels and posts across our channels
  • Winner handover filmed and shared
Live exampleGaming Gift Cards Giveaway (Mega Friday)

Activations

We bring the Mega Rewards crew, screens and prizes to your event or venue and turn the crowd into subscribers.

Includes
  • On-site crew, signage and QR sign-up
  • Sims, Mega Shot for Cash or daily prize draws
  • Live leaderboard and winner screens
  • Content capture on the day
  • Sign-ups attributed to your activation
Live exampleNBL Blitz: Teed it up at Blitz golf
How a campaign runsBrief to launch in about two weeks
  1. 1Brief

    A 20-minute call: your goal, your audience, your prize or budget.

  2. 2Build

    We design the creative, landing page and mechanics inside a week. You approve.

  3. 3Launch

    Email, social, site placement and on-site if it is an activation. Entries open.

  4. 4Report

    Entries, new subscribers, redemptions and the content, all in one wrap-up.

What you get
  • New subscribers attributed to you
  • First-party audience insights
  • Content you can reuse
  • Winner stories
  • A repeatable campaign template
